value.name: Miles buys flowers
value.description: Miles is purchasing a huge bouquet of flowers as the scene begins.
evidence: Miles is buying a huge bouquet of flowers.

value.name: Emily recognizes and confronts Miles
value.description: A woman stops Miles outside the store, recognizes him, and begins confronting him angrily.
evidence: As he exits he is stopped by a WOMAN.

WOMAN
Wait. I know you.

WOMAN
You're Miles Massey!

value.name: Emily accuses Miles of ruining her life
value.description: Emily says Miles ruined her life and snatches the flowers from him.
evidence:
WOMAN
You ruined my life you sonofabitch.
Gimme those.
She grabs the flowers.

value.name: Emily eats a rose petal
value.description: Emily tears a petal off one of the roses and eats it in front of Miles.
evidence: Pulls petal off one of the roses and eats it.

value.name: Emily claims Howard got revenge
value.description: Emily taunts Miles by saying her brother Howard Doyle got him.
evidence: But my brother got you. He got you, you slimeball.

(singsong)
Neener neener neener.

value.name: Nurse intervenes for Emily
value.description: A nurse rushes over and tries to get Emily to return the flowers.
evidence: A NURSE runs over.

NURSE
Emily!

NURSE
I'm sorry, Sir. Emily. Give the man back.

value.name: Emily reveals Howard's marriage scam
value.description: Emily explains that Howard Doyle tricked Miles with a fake wife and phony prenuptial agreement so he would marry Marylin.
evidence: Howard Doyle is my brother? You know my brother, Howard Doyle.
He tricked you. With a phony wife and a fake pre-nup.
You married Marylin, didn't you? You thought she had money.
Howard Doyle made you think that because of what you did to me.
And to Marylin Rexroth.

value.name: Emily confirms revenge motive
value.description: Emily makes clear that Howard's scheme was revenge for Miles's past wrongs against her and Marylin Rexroth.
evidence: Howard Doyle made you think that because of what you did to me.
And to Marylin Rexroth. Yeah. I heard all about it.
My brother Howard Doyle got you.
